Fireball.note: Fire ability - wrong spec for a Frost mage, check spec/macros

advisory: Frostbolt should be the overwhelming majority of casts. Ice Lance is a low-damage instant - only valuable while moving or with Fingers of Frost procs. Fight notes: on movement-heavy fights (Vashj phase 2 striders, Kael weapon phase) lean on Ice Lance and Fire Blast to keep some uptime, but don't spam them while standing still. On AoE/add pulls (Hydross adds, SSC trash, Kael's advisors) swap in Cone of Cold and Arcane Explosion / Blizzard, and keep Frostbolt for single-target priority targets.
